# pve_vm_disk_unlink (Action)

Unlink a VM disk from its base volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_disk_unlink" "example" {
  config {
    idlist = "CHANGE_ME"
    node   = "pve1"
    vmid   = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_disk_unlink.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `idlist` (String) A list of disk IDs you want to delete.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force physical removal. Without this, we simple remove the disk from the config file and create an additional configuration entry called 'unused[n]', which contains the volume ID. Unlink of unused[n] always cause physical removal.
